title: Improving Retrieval-Augmented Deep Assertion Generation via Joint Training
datasets: Data_old: 156,760 Java focal-test/assertion TAP samples; 15,676 test split
Data_new: 265,420 TAP samples, including unknown assertion tokens; 26,542 test split
Defects4J: 835 bugs across 17 projects in separate EvoSuite-prefix fault-detection experiment
models: CodeLlama-7B quantized + LoRA with CodeT5 retriever (separate preliminary variant)
license: Article CC BY 4.0; GitHub source/data repository has no explicit LICENSE; Google Drive checkpoint folder is linked but not inspected
input_setting: Existing Java focal-test prefix -> assertion completion; retrieve similar test/assertion pairs from TAP corpus; separate Defects4J evaluation inserts generated assertion into EvoSuite prefix and checks buggy/fixed behavior
concept_hook: Assertion/oracle generation from test context with external behavioral examples; evaluate actual fault detection on Defects4J
limitation: Not issue-to-BRT or root-cause localization; CodeT5/T5-specific; Qwen decoder-only is not a drop-in; checkpoints external; source license absent
